title: The fight on TV
text: A big MMA card is on TV and he watches it with his mates. One fighter wins with a slam, one with a triangle off his back, and one with a head kick nobody saw coming. Afterwards he can't sleep.

choices.text: The slam. He wants to put people on their backs.
choices.outcome: He's in the wrestling room every morning before school.

choices.text: The triangle. He wants to win from anywhere.
choices.outcome: He rolls every night and starts beating the adults at open mat.

choices.text: The head kick. He wants the knockout nobody sees.
choices.outcome: He kicks the heavy bag until his shins go numb.
